'''Khubeaie''' was a nondescript [[Factory world/Legends|industrial planet]] located in the [[Khubeaie system/Legends|Khubeaie system]], a part of the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was situated at the endpoint of the [[Vaschean Way]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], which linked it to the [[Heffrin system/Legends|Heffrin system]], while the [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route known as the [[Old Corellian Run]] connected it to the [[Vor Deo system/Legends|Vor Deo system]] as well as the [[Ryloth system/Legends|Ryloth system]]<ref name="TEA" /> of the [[Gaulus sector/Legends|Gaulus sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>

Khubeaie was a misty world that was more widely known as a stopover point for [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] transporting [[Spice/Legends|spice]] from the planet [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] to the Arkanis [[Sector/Legends|sector]] world [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] as well as the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] known as the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]]. Members of the [[Human/Legends|Human]], [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]], and [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Species/Legends|species]] could all be found on Khubeaie.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Khubeaie was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square R-17.<ref name="TEA" />
